project.name: InterSystems
project.graph_query: Which files implement the human wiki, LLM wiki, evidence governance, source register, evidence matrix, validation queue, design contract, Graphify publication, verification, dependency management, local service, and deployment?

local_runtime_probe.finding: A listening process is not sufficient health evidence; the declared canonical root returned 404.

formal_conformance.reason: The repository has no .wiki-standard.yaml and uses an intentionally preserved Material implementation. Results below infer its compatibility-profile capabilities without treating renderer difference as a defect.

profile_assessment.declared_legacy_profile: No single current level claim found; repository instructions describe evidence, LLM, graph, design, JJ and deployment contracts.
profile_assessment.closest_candidate_profile: evidence-governed + human-and-agent + material-mkdocs compatibility + graph-linked + design-governed
profile_assessment.summary: A mature Material compatibility exemplar with the richest long-lived LLM operating guide and strong graph freshness checks. It intentionally treats OKF as a future sidecar and currently fails its declared local HTTP health contract.

limitations: Browser graph runtimes are CDN dependencies and the design linter is fetched by npx rather than locked in package-lock.json.
Deployment is documented, but the declared local root returned 404 at audit time.

candidate_false_positive_risks.finding: A loaded service or listening port would have passed incorrectly; the required HTTP probe found 404.
Graph publication files would hide that browser runtimes are remote CDNs.
Documentation discussing OKF must not be mistaken for an implemented export.

candidate_false_negative_risks.finding: A Zensical-only validator would reject a deliberately mature Material compatibility implementation.
sources.md, evidence-matrix.md and evidence-validation-queue.md use root-level legacy paths that a fixed path check would miss.
InterSystems summary.json uses nodeCount/edgeCount while newer projects use nodes/edges; a single hard-coded schema would reject equivalent output.
The design contract is genuinely linted even though package-lock has no local @google/design.md package.

recommendations: Add a DenchCo manifest selecting the Material compatibility adapter and mapping the existing root-level roles.
Diagnose the local 8002 root health failure before asserting runtime conformance; preserve the current process-vs-health distinction.
Generate a non-destructive OKF v0.2 sidecar using the page-role mapping already designed in maintenance.md.
If local-runtime capability is selected, vendor Mermaid and graph libraries and add offline browser checks.
Map complete security, copyright/licensing and source-retention policies, then add a reviewable standard-upgrade workflow.
audit_limitations: The Git working tree was clean at audit time.
The documented public Cloudflare/GitHub URLs were not externally health-probed in this sub-audit.
The local 404 was observed but not diagnosed or fixed because audited projects were read-only.
Graphify query results were supplemented by direct source inspection due limited semantic recall.
